fusions.name: Silk Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a glob of silk that deals 12 damage and wraps the target, stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped Meal
fusions.desc: Bites a target at or below 25% health, dealing 20 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction on the target, and each adds 50% more damage.

fusions.name: Lure Lines
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Warden
fusions.desc: A bonded spider fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds; each enemy it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
